Implemented between FY 2022-2026 under the \"Skill India Programme\", the scheme component \"Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 - Short-Term Training\" by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Government of India, aims to deliver market-oriented and demand-driven skill training to youth and to enhance their employability through industry-relevant, NSQF-aligned courses with an inherent On-the-Job Training component. Through this scheme component, free NSQF-aligned skill training ranging between 300 and 600 hours, On-the-Job Training (OJT), an induction kit, assessment and certification, accidental insurance, and applicable allowances are provided to candidates looking for fresh skilling, re-skilling, or upskilling, including out-of-education candidates, school/college dropouts, and unemployed youth of Indian nationality. The scheme is implemented by the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), the implementing arm of MSDE and the designated Central Nodal Agency (CNA), through accredited and affiliated Training Centres.. The scheme aims to provide demand-driven, employability-focused skill training. Through this scheme, free NSQF-aligned training, On-the-Job Training, certification, and allowances are provided to Indian youth.. The scheme provides free NSQF-aligned skill training ranging between 300 and 600 hours; courses of higher duration based on industry/sectoral demand can also be offered, and training in higher-level NSQF job roles (level 5, 6 and above) is also imparted. On-the-Job Training (OJT) is provided as an inherent component to give candidates practical exposure and a live-work environment, with the duration guided by the approved Qualification Pack.
